claims.text: LMWH = preferred anticoag for cancer-associated thrombosis.
claims.quote: Low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) remains the preferred anticoagulation option for the management of cancer-associated thrombosis.

claims.text: Other options: DOACs (apixaban, rivaroxaban, edoxaban), fondaparinux, warfarin;
claims.quote: Other treatment options include direct oral anticoagulants like apixaban, rivaroxaban, edoxaban, fondaparinux, and warfarin.

claims.text: apixaban ⍉inferior to LMWH w.o ↑ major bleed.
claims.quote: In the Caravaggio trial, researchers found apixaban to be non-inferior to LMWH in the treatment of cancer-associated VTE without an increased risk of significant bleeding.
